questions.q: What did Jung call coincidences that have an inner meaning?
questions.e: In the video: "Jung je ovu pojavu nazvao sinhronicitet" — Jung called this phenomenon synchronicity.

questions.q: What, according to Jung, should you ask yourself in a difficult situation?
questions.e: In the video: "šta me ovo uči" — what is this teaching me.

questions.q: How does the author describe the link between the inner and outer worlds?
o: They are not connected at all
questions.e: In the video: "naš unutrašnji svet neprekidno u dijalogu sa spoljnim" — our inner world is in constant dialogue with the outer one.

questions.q: What does the author say about pain?
questions.e: In the video: "taj bol nije uzaludan" — that pain is not in vain.

questions.q: What does the author call what we consider a failure?
questions.e: In the video: "bio je putokaz" — it was a signpost.

questions.q: What does loss teach us, according to the video?
questions.e: In the video: "Gubitak nas je naučio da cenimo prisutnost" — loss taught us to value presence.

questions.q: What way of life does the author contrast with a linear trajectory?
questions.e: In the video: "život nije linearna putanja, već krugovi, spirale" — life is not a linear trajectory, but circles, spirals.

questions.q: What does the author ask the viewers at the end?
o: Whether they have experienced a coincidence that changed their life
questions.e: In the video: "da li ste ikada doživeli slučajnost koja vam je promenila život" — have you ever experienced a coincidence that changed your life.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Ništa nije *slučajno*.
Pojedinac je deo *kolektivnog* iskustva.
Sve ima svoj *smisao*.
Bol nas je naučio *saosećanju*.
Gubitak nas uči *ceniti* ono što imamo.
Treba da *oslušneš* svoju intuiciju.
Život je *putovanje* ka sebi.
Ne *požuruj* stvari.
questions.e: Požurivati — to rush, to hurry someone.

questions.q: Jung nije verovao u ___ preživljavanje.
Razmišljate o starom ___.
questions.e: O + locative case: o starom prijatelju.

questions.q: Sve što nam se događa, događa se ___ razlogom.
Ne krivimo ___ za svoje patnje.
Život nas uvek ___ nečemu.
U ___ trenucima osećamo da smo vođeni.
Ti si deo ___ celine.
questions.e: Deo + genitive case, feminine: deo veće celine.

questions.q: Sve što si ___ kao slučajnost bilo je odgovor.
